title: I Scanned My Claude Skills And Found Real Malware
description:
NVIDIA's research found 26.1% of AI agent skills contain security vulnerabilities and 5.2% show likely malicious intent. Skills run with the same access you have: your files, your logins, your API keys, and nothing reviews them before installation. SkillSpector is NVIDIA's free open-source scanner for exactly this. Point it at a directory, a zip, a single SKILL.md or a Git URL, and it returns a 0 to 100 risk score with a plain list of findings across 71 vulnerability patterns. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and MCP servers.

Get the free guide with the install and scan commands here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EZJNfmJyK9-4r8sZGHNzbR5RrOYIGH14lMiQt_nLQRg/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #CyberSecurity
